senses.definition: n.[m.] swath, row of fallen grain (hay, as Mishn., according to Vogelsteinl.c. 74f. (who is then compelled to read עֹמֶר Mi 4:12), cf. Syriac ܥܡܺܝܪ grass, SchwallyIdiot. 69);—Am 2:13 (on cart), Je 9:21 (falling behind reaper), Mi 4:12 (brought to threshing-floor), Zc 12:6 (inflammable).
